study.title: The effects of sodium reduction and the DASH diet on ambulatory blood pressure: overall and race-stratified results from the DASH-Sodium trial

primary_findings.quote: the DASH diet with low sodium reduced mean (95%CI) awake SBP by 9.0 mmHg (6.4, 11.7) in Black participants
the DASH diet with low sodium reduced mean (95%CI) awake SBP by 7.5 mmHg (4.5, 10.6) in Non-Black participants
mean asleep SBP by 8.0 mmHg (4.8, 11.2) in Black participants
mean asleep SBP by 7.4 mmHg (3.9,11.0) in Non-Black participants
